description: This file defines a collection of functions that generate PostgreSQL protocol message buffers for testing purposes, including functions for different message types such as authentication, command completion, data rows, and more. It also imports an external BufferList class used for constructing the buffers.

methods.name: readyForQuery
methods.description: Creates a BufferList representing a 'ready for query' protocol message.

methods.name: authenticationOk
methods.description: Creates a BufferList indicating successful authentication.

methods.name: authenticationCleartextPassword
methods.description: Creates a BufferList for cleartext password authentication message.

methods.name: authenticationMD5Password
methods.description: Creates a BufferList for MD5 password authentication with salt.

methods.name: authenticationSASL
methods.description: Creates a BufferList initiating SASL authentication with mechanism 'SCRAM-SHA-256'.

methods.name: authenticationSASLContinue
methods.description: Creates a BufferList for continuing SASL authentication with data.

methods.name: authenticationSASLFinal
methods.description: Creates a BufferList for final SASL message with data.

methods.name: parameterStatus
methods.description: Creates a BufferList for a parameter status message with name and value.

methods.name: backendKeyData
methods.description: Creates a BufferList containing backend process ID and secret key.

methods.name: commandComplete
methods.description: Creates a BufferList signaling completion of a command.

methods.name: rowDescription
methods.description: Creates a BufferList describing the format of rows with an array of field descriptors.

methods.name: parameterDescription
methods.description: Creates a BufferList describing data types of parameters.

methods.name: dataRow
methods.description: Creates a BufferList representing a data row with column data.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Creates a BufferList for an error message with fields.

methods.name: notice
methods.description: Creates a BufferList for a notice message with fields.

methods.name: errorOrNotice
methods.description: Helper function to construct common parts of error or notice messages.

methods.name: parseComplete
methods.description: Creates a BufferList indicating parse complete.

methods.name: bindComplete
methods.description: Creates a BufferList indicating bind complete.

methods.name: notification
methods.description: Creates a BufferList for a notification message with ID, channel, and payload.

methods.name: emptyQuery
methods.description: Creates a BufferList for an empty query.

methods.name: portalSuspended
methods.description: Creates a BufferList indicating portal suspended.

methods.name: closeComplete
methods.description: Creates a BufferList indicating close complete.

methods.name: copyIn
methods.description: Creates a BufferList for COPY IN operation with specified column count.

methods.name: copyOut
methods.description: Creates a BufferList for COPY OUT operation with specified column count.

methods.name: copyData
methods.description: Creates a BufferList containing copy data bytes.

methods.name: copyDone
methods.description: Creates a BufferList indicating copy operation is done.
